title: Asteroid Collision Problem

content.problemStatement:
You're given a list of integers representing asteroids in a row, all moving at the same speed. Each asteroid's absolute value is its size, and its sign is its direction: positive means moving right, negative means moving left.

**Return the state of the asteroids after all collisions have been resolved, from left to right.**

When two moving asteroids meet, the smaller one explodes; if they're the same size, both explode. Two asteroids moving in the same direction never collide.
content.inputFormat: Single line: JSON array of all arguments, e.g. [arg1, arg2, ...]

sampleTestCases.explanation: 10 (moving right) collides with -5 (moving left); 10 is bigger, so -5 explodes and 10 survives; 5 was already moving right and never meets anything
equal sizes moving toward each other - both explode
2 (moving right) collides with -5 (moving left) first; 2 is smaller so it explodes; then -5 collides with 10; -5 is smaller so it explodes; 10 survives untouched

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
#  YOUR SOLUTION  <- Write your code inside the method below
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Time:  O(n)
# Space: O(n)

class Solution(object):
    def asteroidCollision(self, asteroids):
        """
        :type asteroids: List[int]
        :rtype: List[int]
        """
        result = []
        for x in asteroids:
            if x > 0:
                result.append(x)
                continue
            while result and 0 < result[-1] < -x:
                result.pop()
            if result and 0 < result[-1]:
                if result[-1] == -x:
                    result.pop()
                continue
            result.append(x)
        return result

if __name__ == '__main__':
    args = json.loads(sys.stdin.readline())
    if not isinstance(args, list):
        args = [args]
    res = Solution().asteroidCollision(*args[:1])
    print(json.dumps(res, separators=(',', ':')))
